project.name: agent_monitor
project.description: Python library implementing the Adaptive Multi-Dimensional Monitoring (AMDM) algorithm (Shukla 2025, arXiv:2509.00115) for agentic AI systems: Tier 1 streaming per-axis EWMA + joint Mahalanobis anomaly detection over aggregate metric matrices, and Tier 2 per-session Mahalanobis scoring with winsorized population estimates and stratified human-review queue allocation.
project.overview: Hybrid FP/OOP design: all computation is pure functions over an immutable, Parquet-checkpointable MonitorState (frozen dataclasses, read-only NumPy arrays); side effects are confined to checkpoint.py (Parquet I/O) and a thin Monitor facade. Two deployment modes: long-lived streaming services (in-memory state + periodic checkpoints) and Airflow PythonOperator batches (restore -> advance -> score -> save). Data loading is out of scope; callers supply pre-aligned tick matrices and raw per-axis session features. No Rust in v0; pure NumPy/SciPy. Reference-implementation parity (references/AMDM.py) is the primary correctness oracle.

data_schemas.name: MonitorConfig
data_schemas.description: Frozen construction-time configuration; topology fixed at construction and stored in every state snapshot. Paper defaults: w=80, lambda=0.25, k=None (resolves to chi2_A(0.99)), alpha=0.01, min_warm=30, ridge=1e-6, agg='mean'.

fields.name: axis_names
fields.description: tuple[str, ...], A >= 2 axis names

fields.name: metric_names
fields.description: tuple[tuple[str, ...], ...], >= 1 metric name per axis

fields.name: window
fields.description: int w >= 2, rolling window length; default 80

fields.name: lam
fields.description: float EWMA smoothing, 0 < lam <= 1; default 0.25

fields.name: k
fields.description: float | None per-axis sensitivity multiplier; None resolves to chi2.ppf(0.99, df=A)

fields.name: alpha
fields.description: float joint false-alarm rate; default 0.01

fields.name: min_warm
fields.description: int joint detector warm-up ticks, >= 2; default 30

fields.name: ridge
fields.description: float covariance regularization epsilon; default 1e-6

fields.name: agg
fields.description: str aggregation registry key: 'mean' | 'max' | 'l2'; default 'mean'

fields.name: population_window
fields.description: int >= 1, Tier 2 covariance window in ticks; default 80

fields.name: min_population
fields.description: int sessions required before Tier 2 scoring; default 30

fields.name: winsor_pct
fields.description: float | None per-axis clip percentile, two-sided [q_{1-p}, q_p]; None disables winsorization; default 0.99

fields.name: winsor_k
fields.description: int quantile lookback multiplier: retention = max(population_window, window * winsor_k) ticks; default 3

data_schemas.name: QueueConfig
data_schemas.description: Frozen review-queue budgets, per build call. Defaults (200/150/100/100/50) assume one build per day; per-tick users must scale.

fields.name: top_k
fields.description: int >= 0, stratum 1: highest d2 sessions

fields.name: flagged
fields.description: int >= 0, stratum 2: sessions from AMDM-flagged ticks

fields.name: per_axis
fields.description: int >= 0, stratum 3: floor(per_axis / A) per axis, most extreme first

fields.name: uniform
fields.description: int >= 0, stratum 4: seeded uniform random from remainder

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: int >= 0, stratum 5: analyst reserve; library never fills it

fields.name: seed
fields.description: int RNG seed for reproducible random strata; default 0

fields.name: theta

fields.name: axis_buf

fields.name: axis_count

fields.name: mu

data_schemas.description: Per-tick input: one complete, caller-aligned metric matrix (Tier 1).

data_schemas.name: SessionWindow
data_schemas.description: Immutable Tier 2 population store: session feature rows retained for retention = max(population_window, window * winsor_k) ticks. Covariance uses the last population_window ticks; winsor quantiles use the full retention.

fields.name: ids
fields.description: np.ndarray (R,) read-only unique session ids

fields.name: ticks
fields.description: np.ndarray (R,) int64 read-only tick of each row

fields.name: features
fields.description: np.ndarray (R, A) float64 read-only raw feature values

fields.name: tick_flagged
fields.description: np.ndarray (R,) bool read-out: was the row's tick AMDM-flagged

fields.name: absorbed_at
fields.description: np.ndarray (R,) int64 read-only tick at which the row entered the window

data_schemas.name: CheckpointParquetSchema
data_schemas.description: On-disk checkpoint: a directory (atomic temp-dir + rename write) containing state.parquet (single row, nested pyarrow columns, format_version=1, config_json, tick, metric_buf, metric_count, theta, axis_buf, axis_count, joint_n, joint_mu, joint_M2) and population.parquet (tabular: session_id, tick, features, tick_flagged, absorbed_at). Loading is data-only (no pickle, no code execution); loaders reject unknown format_version.

fields.name: format_version
fields.description: int64 schema version; currently 1

fields.name: state.parquet
fields.description: single-row nested Parquet table holding all Tier 1 + joint state and config_json

fields.name: population.parquet
fields.description: tabular Parquet, one row per retained session (session_id, tick, features list<double>, tick_flagged, absorbed_at)

api_contracts.name: config.validate_monitor_config
api_contracts.description: Validates MonitorConfig invariants (A >= 2; M_a >= 1; 0 < lam <= 1; w >= 2; min_warm >= 2; population_window >= 1; winsor_k >= 1; 0 < winsor_pct < 1 when not None; known agg name; k > 0 when provided). Resolves k=None to chi2.ppf(0.99, df=A).

api_contracts.name: config.json codec
api_contracts.description: Canonical JSON encode/decode of MonitorConfig for the Parquet checkpoint config_json column.
raises: ValueError on malformed JSON or unknown agg name

api_contracts.name: agg.get_agg
api_contracts.description: Aggregation registry: 'mean' | 'max' | 'l2' -> pure function over a non-empty list of z-scores. Empty input raises ValueError (callers handle warm-up None before calling).

api_contracts.name: normalizer.zscore
api_contracts.description: Step 1: append x to one metric's ring buffer, return (z, new_buffer, new_count). z=None until >= 2 samples; z=0.0 when sigma < 1e-10 (constant metric).

api_contracts.name: axis.update_axis
api_contracts.description: Steps 2-4 for one axis: z-score all metrics, S_A = agg(valid z-scores), EWMA theta_A cold-starts at first S_A, flag iff sigma_S > 1e-10 and |S_A - theta_A| > k * sigma_S (sigma_S over the full S_A window). Returns new state slice + AxisResult.

inputs.name: X_a
inputs.description: M_a raw metric readings this tick

raises: ValueError if X_a length != M_a or non-finite values

api_contracts.name: joint.welford_update
api_contracts.description: Step 5a: rank-one Welford mean + scatter update; incorporates S(t) only (no lookahead).

api_contracts.name: joint.d_squared
raises: numpy.linalg.LinAlgError if sigma_inv is not invertible (pre-validated upstream)

api_contracts.name: joint.update_joint
api_contracts.description: Steps 5-6: Welford update with S(t); Sigma = M2/(n-1) + ridge*I, full inversion (O(A^3), A small); warming-up result until n >= min_warm; then D2, p_value = chi2.sf(D2, A), flagged = D2 > chi2.ppf(1-alpha, A).
raises: numpy.linalg.LinAlgError if ridge-regularized Sigma is singular (informative message)

api_contracts.name: advance
api_contracts.description: Top-level pure orchestration: axis updates -> S_vector (0.0-fill during axis warm-up, reference parity) -> joint update -> TickResult. state(t+1) depends on ticks 0..t only.
raises: ValueError on shape mismatch or non-finite input

api_contracts.name: population.absorb
api_contracts.description: Append session rows (dedup on session_id, including ids already retained), evict rows with tick < state.tick - retention + 1 where retention = max(population_window, window * winsor_k). Records tick_flagged for the sessions' tick.

inputs.name: tick_flagged
inputs.description: whether the sessions' tick raised alert

raises: ValueError on duplicate ids within the batch or shape mismatch

api_contracts.name: population.winsor_caps
api_contracts.description: Per-axis two-sided clip bounds [q_{1-p}, q_p] (p = winsor_pct) computed over the FULL retention window. None while winsor_pct is None (disabled) or retained rows < 100 (warm-up).

outputs.name: caps
outputs.description: caps[0] = lower, caps[1] = upper; lower <= upper

api_contracts.name: population.population_stats
api_contracts.description: (mu, Sigma_inv, n) over the last population_window ticks of winsorized rows (clipped to winsor_caps; raw rows while caps are None). None until n >= min_population. Lazy exact computation from the window; Sigma = cov(clipped rows) + ridge*I.
raises: numpy.linalg.LinAlgError if regularized covariance is singular

api_contracts.name: population.score_sessions
api_contracts.description: Batch d2 + chi-square p-values for candidate sessions vs population stats. Candidates are scored RAW (never clipped). None d2/p_value per session while population n < min_population.

api_contracts.name: queue.build_review_queue
api_contracts.description: Five-stratum allocation from current-tick candidates in priority order (top_k > flagged > per_axis > uniform > reserved): disjoint membership, min(budget, available) per stratum, shortfall cascades to next stratum within the same build, seeded RNG for random strata, reserved never filled.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: for flagged-tick history and population stats

api_contracts.name: checkpoint.save_checkpoint
api_contracts.description: I/O edge: serialize state to a Parquet checkpoint directory via temp dir + atomic rename.

api_contracts.name: checkpoint.load_checkpoint
api_contracts.description: I/O edge: load + validate checkpoint (format_version == 1, config shape vs array shapes); returns MonitorState with all arrays read-only.
raises: ValueError on unknown format_version or shape mismatch

api_contracts.name: monitor.Monitor
api_contracts.description: The only stateful class: holds current MonitorState, delegates to the pure core, rebinds on update. Methods: __init__(config), restore(path) classmethod, update(tick) -> TickResult, absorb(sessions), score(sessions) -> scores, review_queue(tick_result, sessions, qcfg) -> plan, save(path). update() records tick_flagged on sessions absorbed in the same tick.

outputs.name: monitor
outputs.description: facade instance; no detection logic of its own

features.name: Types & config
features.description: src/agent_monitor/types.py + config.py: all DS-001..DS-011 frozen dataclasses (zero logic), MonitorConfig/QueueConfig validation, k=None -> chi2_A(0.99) resolution, canonical JSON codec for checkpoints.

invariants.temporal_bounds: Configs are construction-time constants; no temporal dependence.
invariants.accounting_oracle: Validation rules in plan section 3.1: A >= 2, M_a >= 1, 0 < lam <= 1, w >= 2, min_warm >= 2, population_window >= 1, strata >= 0, 0 < winsor_pct < 1 or None, known agg name.
invariants.plausibility_range: resolved k = chi2.ppf(0.99, df=A); for A=5, k in [15.086, 15.087].

strategies: valid-config generation -> validation accepts and round-trips
boundary violation -> ValueError for each rule

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Non-critical module (dataclasses + validation); covered by unit and property tests per user directive to restrict mutation testing.

acceptance_criteria: uv run pytest tests/test_config.py passes: every validation rule has an accept-case and a reject-case
k=None resolves to scipy.stats.chi2.ppf(0.99, df=A) within 1e-9 (A=5 -> 15.0863)
config_to_json -> config_from_json round-trip yields dataclass-equal MonitorConfig
mypy --strict clean on types.py and config.py
test_requirements: tests/test_config.py (unit + hypothesis on validation and JSON codec)
edge_cases: unknown agg name rejected at construction (plan R12)
winsor_pct boundary: 0 and 1 rejected; None accepted

features.name: Aggregation registry
features.description: src/agent_monitor/agg.py: registry mapping 'mean' | 'max' | 'l2' to pure functions over non-empty z-score sequences; empty input raises ValueError (axis warm-up is handled upstream).

invariants.temporal_bounds: Pointwise function of its input sequence; no temporal dependence.
invariants.accounting_oracle: mean == statistics.fmean; max == builtin max; l2 == sqrt(sum(z^2)) computed independently in tests.
invariants.plausibility_range: mean(z) in [min(z), max(z)] for all inputs; all outputs finite for finite inputs.

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Trivial pure functions; oracle-exact property tests provide equivalent rigor without mutation overhead.

acceptance_criteria: each of mean/max/l2 matches its independent oracle within 1e-12 on >= 100 hypothesis-generated sequences
registry lookup with unknown name raises KeyError
empty input raises ValueError for all three functions
test_requirements: tests/test_agg.py (unit + hypothesis)
edge_cases: mixed +inf/-inf excluded by upstream finite-input contract

features.name: Rolling z-score normalizer
features.description: src/agent_monitor/normalizer.py (Step 1): ring-buffer z-scores per metric with constant-metric guard and warm-up None semantics.

invariants.temporal_bounds: z_i(t) is a function of x_i(0..t) only (ring buffer contents); no future samples.
invariants.accounting_oracle: z == (x - np.mean(buf_valid)) / np.std(buf_valid, ddof=1) recomputed from stored buffer, exact to 1e-12.
invariants.plausibility_range: z finite; z == 0.0 iff sigma < 1e-10; over iid N(0,1) inputs, filled-window z has |mean| < 0.15 and std in [0.85, 1.15].

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(w) per metric per tick (mean/std over the window)

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Covered by exact-oracle property tests (plan section 5, 2a) and parity test F-006; outside the restricted critical set per user directive.

acceptance_criteria: zscore returns (None, buf', count') while count < 2
zscore returns 0.0 when window sigma < 1e-10 (constant metric)
hypothesis: z matches the buffer-recomputed oracle within 1e-12 on >= 1000 generated streams
after w + 5 updates the buffer contains exactly the last w samples (eviction exact)
test_requirements: tests/test_normalizer.py (unit + hypothesis)

features.name: Per-axis monitor
features.description: src/agent_monitor/axis.py (Steps 2-4): S_A aggregation, EWMA theta_A with cold start at first S_A, sigma_S over full S_A window, flag iff sigma_S > 1e-10 and |S_A - theta_A| > k * sigma_S.

invariants.temporal_bounds: theta_A(t) = f(S_A(t), theta_A(t-1)) only; [T2] no future S_A incorporation.
invariants.accounting_oracle: S_A == agg_fn(z-scores) recomputed independently; theta recurrence theta(t) = lam*S_A + (1-lam)*theta(t-1) verified stepwise to 1e-12.
invariants.plausibility_range: flagged == False whenever sigma_S <= 1e-10; flagged == (deviation > k * sigma_S) otherwise, exact predicate.

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(M_a + w) per axis per tick

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Covered by stepwise oracle tests and reference parity (F-006); outside the restricted critical set per user directive.

acceptance_criteria: S_A equals agg applied to the normalizer's valid z-scores within 1e-12
theta cold-starts at first S_A and thereafter follows the EWMA recurrence within 1e-12
flagged is False whenever sigma_S <= 1e-10 (plan R3 guard)
flagged equals the exact predicate |S_A - theta_A| > k * sigma_S on >= 1000 hypothesis cases
test_requirements: tests/test_axis.py (unit + hypothesis)

features.name: Joint anomaly detector
features.description: src/agent_monitor/joint.py (Steps 5-6) [CRITICAL]: Welford rank-one mean/scatter, ridge-regularized Sigma inversion, D2, chi-square p-value and threshold, min_warm gate. mutmut target.

invariants.temporal_bounds: [T2] Welford (n, mu, M2) at tick t incorporates S(t) and prior state only; never S(t+1).
invariants.accounting_oracle: [O1] Welford mean == np.mean and scatter == np.cov(ddof=1) on identical input sequences, to 1e-9.
invariants.plausibility_range: D2 >= 0 always; p_value in [0, 1]; threshold == chi2.ppf(1-alpha, A) exactly; flagged == (D2 > threshold).

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(A^3) per tick (full inversion, A <= ~10); Welford update O(A^2)

strategies: random (S, A) score sequences for Welford-vs-np.cov oracle

acceptance_criteria: [O1] Welford mean and scatter match np.mean/np.cov(ddof=1) within 1e-9 on >= 100 hypothesis-generated sequences
D2 >= 0 and p_value in [0, 1] on all generated inputs (no NaN/Inf)
warming-up result (D2=None, flagged=False) returned for n < min_warm
flagged equals (D2 > chi2.ppf(1-alpha, A)) exactly on all generated inputs
mutmut on joint.py: all surviving mutants killed or explicitly justified in MUTATION_NOTES.md
test_requirements: tests/test_joint.py (unit + hypothesis oracle tests)
mutmut run restricted to src/agent_monitor/joint.py (F-013 enforces)
edge_cases: singular/degenerate scatter (plan R1: ridge + informative LinAlgError)

features.name: advance orchestration + reference parity
features.description: Top-level pure advance(state, tick) -> (state', TickResult) wiring Steps 1-6 (0.0-fill S entries during axis warm-up, reference parity), plus [O3] parity suite against references/AMDM.py on the three seeded scenarios.

invariants.temporal_bounds: [T1] result(t) and state(t) are functions of ticks 0..t only; streaming advance == batch recompute over the full prefix to 1e-12.
invariants.accounting_oracle: [O3] references/AMDM.py on identical seeded inputs: S_A, theta, D2 and all flags match to 1e-9; detection matrix reproduced: normal -> silent; coordinated +1.5sigma shift -> joint-flag only; single-axis x20sigma spike -> axis + joint flags.
invariants.plausibility_range: alert == any_axis_flag or joint_flag; S_vector length A; 0.0-fill only during axis warm-up.
invariants.realism_requirements: [R1] Three seeded scenario streams spanning warm-up -> steady state -> coordinated shift -> extreme spike, at realistic tick counts (>= 60 baseline ticks), not single-shot mocks.

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(A * M_max * w) per tick, dominated by normalizer; A*M*w ~ 4e3 default

strategies: random finite tick matrices, no-lookahead prefix-equivalence property (T1)

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Orchestration only (no math of its own); guarded by parity oracle [O3] and no-lookahead property tests.

acceptance_criteria: [O3] S_A, theta, D2 match references/AMDM.py within 1e-9 on all three seeded scenarios, including 0.0-fill warm-up behavior
[O3] detection matrix exact: normal silent; +1.5sigma coordinated shift -> joint_flag and not any_axis_flag; safety x20sigma spike -> any_axis_flag and joint_flag
[T1] streaming advance over >= 1000 generated ticks equals batch recompute over the prefix within 1e-12
TickResult.alert == (any_axis_flag or joint_flag) exactly
test_requirements: tests/test_advance.py (unit + hypothesis no-lookahead)
tests/test_parity_integration.py (multi-module integration test: full pipeline vs references/AMDM.py; required to satisfy the INTEGRATION-scope [O3] invariant)
edge_cases: 0.0-fill during axis warm-up biases early joint mu/Sigma (plan R2, accepted reference-parity choice)

features.name: Population window, winsorization & stats
features.description: src/agent_monitor/population.py (Tier 2 core) [CRITICAL]: absorb/dedup/evict with retention = max(population_window, window*winsor_k); two-sided winsor caps over full retention; exact winsorized empirical (mu, Sigma_inv) over last population_window ticks with ridge + singularity guard. mutmut target.

invariants.temporal_bounds: absorb at tick t only appends rows with tick <= t and evicts by cutoff t - retention + 1; stats use retained rows only.
invariants.accounting_oracle: [A2] rows_retained <= capacity and no row with tick < state.tick - retention + 1 survives absorb. [O2] population_stats == clip-then-cov oracle: np.mean/np.cov over window rows clipped to winsor_caps (raw rows while caps None), to 1e-9.
invariants.plausibility_range: caps: lower <= upper per axis, both finite; caps None iff winsor_pct is None or retained rows < 100; stats None until n >= min_population.

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: absorb O(R + S); caps O(R*A); stats O(R_cov * A^2) per scoring call (lazy recompute, no incremental scatter state)

strategies: random session batches with duplicate ids and old ticks (eviction)
contaminated windows (spike rows) to verify cap stability

acceptance_criteria: absorb dedups on session_id (within batch and vs retained rows); duplicate ids raise ValueError or are skipped per documented contract
[A2] after absorb at tick t, zero rows have tick < t - retention + 1 and rows_retained <= capacity (property test)
[O2] population_stats matches explicit clip -> np.mean/np.cov oracle within 1e-9 (both with and without caps)
winsor_caps: None while winsor_pct is None or retained rows < 100; otherwise equals np.quantile(rows, [1-p, p], axis=0) within 1e-12, with lower <= upper
mutmut on population.py: all surviving mutants killed or explicitly justified in MUTATION_NOTES.md
test_requirements: tests/test_population.py (unit + hypothesis: eviction, dedup, clip-then-cov oracle)
mutmut run restricted to src/agent_monitor/population.py (F-013 enforces)
edge_cases: population contamination by anomalies (plan R5 -> winsorization)
duplicate session ids across ticks (plan R6)

features.name: Session scoring
features.description: Batch d2 + p-values for candidate sessions vs winsorized population (Tier 2). Candidates scored RAW (never clipped). Vectorized via (F - mu) @ Sigma_inv.

invariants.temporal_bounds: Scoring at tick t uses population rows with tick <= t only.
invariants.accounting_oracle: batch d2 identical to per-session d_squared loop within 1e-12.
invariants.plausibility_range: d2 >= 0; p_value in [0,1]; None while population n < min_population (no silent zeros, plan R11). [P4] a candidate beyond a cap scores strictly greater d2 than one at the cap.

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(S * A^2) per batch, vectorized (plan R9: 1e7 sessions feasible); no per-session Python loops

acceptance_criteria: batch d2 matches per-session d_squared loop within 1e-12 on >= 100 generated batches
scores have d2=None, p_value=None while population n < min_population
[P4] candidate feature beyond cap yields strictly greater d2 than identical candidate with feature at the cap
all emitted d2/p_value finite (no NaN/Inf) on adversarial finite inputs
test_requirements: tests/test_scoring.py (unit + hypothesis, incl. [P4] ordering property)
edge_cases: min_population never reached in low-volume deployments (plan R11)
singular covariance raises informative LinAlgError (plan R1)

features.name: Review queue stratification
features.description: src/agent_monitor/queue.py [CRITICAL]: five strata (top_k, flagged, per_axis, uniform, reserved) in priority order; disjoint membership; min(budget, available) with shortfall cascade within the same build call; seeded RNG; reserved never filled. mutmut target.

invariants.temporal_bounds: Plan built from current-tick candidates and population rows with tick <= t only.
invariants.accounting_oracle: [A1] strata pairwise disjoint; |stratum| == min(budget, available_after_higher_priority_strata); no session appears twice; reserved always empty. Oracle: QueueConfig budgets vs realized plan sizes. [D1] same (state, seed, inputs) -> identical plan.
invariants.plausibility_range: selected + unallocated == candidate set exactly (set equality); total selected <= sum(top_k, flagged, per_axis, uniform).

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(S log S) per build call (sort for top-k; per-axis maxima vectorized)

strategies: random candidate pools with budget starvation
duplicate/overlapping eligibility (session both top-k and flagged)

[A1] 'reserved' key present and always empty; library never fills it
[D1] identical (state, seed, inputs) produce identical plans (dataclass equality); different seed changes the uniform stratum given enough candidates
shortfall cascade: unmet top_k budget flows to flagged stratum within the same build call (explicit test)
selected + unallocated == candidate set exactly (accounting test)
mutmut on queue.py: all surviving mutants killed or explicitly justified in MUTATION_NOTES.md

features.name: Parquet checkpoint persistence
features.description: src/agent_monitor/checkpoint.py (the only I/O module): save state to a Parquet checkpoint directory (state.parquet nested single-row + population.parquet tabular, DS-012) via temp-dir + atomic rename; load with format_version and shape validation; arrays re-marked read-only.

invariants.temporal_bounds: Persistence of state(t) only; no implicit advancement on load.
invariants.accounting_oracle: [D2] load(save(state)) yields arrays byte-equal (np.array_equal, writeable flags False) and the next advance produces identical results within 1e-12.
invariants.plausibility_range: checkpoint contains format_version == 1; loading is data-only (no pickle, no code execution).
invariants.realism_requirements: Round-trip tested on a state that has passed warm-up and carries a non-empty population window (not an empty-state mock).

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: O(R) serialization cost, R retained session rows (default retention 240 ticks)

property_based_testing.rationale_if_disabled: I/O boundary; round-trip identity is a deterministic integration property covered by explicit integration tests.

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Pure I/O boundary per user directive; correctness enforced by [D2] round-trip integration tests and version-gate tests.

acceptance_criteria: [D2] save -> load round-trip: all arrays byte-equal (np.array_equal), writeable == False, config dataclass-equal
[D2] the next advance after a round-trip is identical to the non-persisted path within 1e-12 (integration test)
load rejects format_version != 1 with an explicit ValueError (plan R7)
save writes atomically: temp-dir + rename; an injected mid-write failure leaves any pre-existing checkpoint intact (plan R8)
test_requirements: tests/test_checkpoint.py (unit)
tests/test_checkpoint_integration.py (multi-module round-trip [D2]; required to satisfy the INTEGRATION-scope invariant)

features.name: Monitor facade
features.description: src/agent_monitor/monitor.py: the only stateful class. Delegates to the pure core, rebinds state, records tick_flagged on sessions absorbed in the same tick, restore/save passthrough. No detection logic of its own.

invariants.temporal_bounds: Facade state at time t equals pure state after ticks 0..t; update() never peeks ahead.
invariants.accounting_oracle: Monitor.update(tick) result is identical to advance(state, tick) on the equivalent pure state within 1e-12; Monitor.restore(path).state equals load_checkpoint(path).
invariants.plausibility_range: update() records tick_flagged = tick_result.alert on sessions absorbed for that tick.
invariants.realism_requirements: Airflow-style usage path (restore -> advance -> absorb -> score -> save) exercised end-to-end in the integration test.

property_based_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Thin delegation wrapper; equivalence to the pure core is deterministically tested, not statistically.

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: No logic of its own (delegation only); outside restricted critical set per user directive.

acceptance_criteria: Monitor.update(tick) results identical to advance() pure calls across >= 100 ticks within 1e-12
Monitor.restore(path) state equals load_checkpoint(path); Monitor.save(path) yields a loadable checkpoint (integration test)
sessions absorbed in the same tick as update() carry tick_flagged == tick_result.alert
README documents the Airflow-style restore -> advance -> absorb -> score -> save workflow

tests/test_monitor_integration.py (multi-module Airflow-style workflow; required to satisfy the INTEGRATION-scope invariant)

features.name: Property-based soak tests
features.description: Cross-module hypothesis/Monte-Carlo hardening: no-lookahead equivalence, Tier 1 and Tier 2 long-run H0 behavior, NaN/Inf-free outputs under adversarial inputs, full-lifecycle realism streams.

invariants.temporal_bounds: [T1] streaming == batch replay over prefixes of >= 10^3 generated ticks within 1e-12.
invariants.accounting_oracle: [P1] Tier 1: mean D2 within 5% of A and flag rate within [0.5*alpha, 2*alpha] over >= 10^4 iid ticks after warm-up. [P3] Tier 2: mean d2 within 10% of A and flag rate within [alpha, 2*alpha] over >= 10^4 Monte-Carlo sessions (band reflects winsorization variance shrinkage).
invariants.plausibility_range: [P2] no NaN/Inf in any result field under any valid adversarial input (constant metrics, zero-variance axes, extreme magnitudes).
invariants.realism_requirements: [R1] Full lifecycle synthetic streams: warm-up -> steady state -> drift -> spike -> recovery at realistic tick cadence (>= 60 baseline ticks, >= 100 total), not single-shot mocks.

performance_requirements.complexity_budget: Test-only; 10^4 ticks x O(A*M*w) ~ seconds wall time

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Test-only feature; no production code to mutate.

acceptance_criteria: [T1] streaming == batch replay within 1e-12 over >= 100 generated tick prefixes
[P1] over >= 10^4 iid ticks: mean D2 within 5% of A; Tier 1 flag rate in [0.5*alpha, 2*alpha] after warm-up
[P3] over >= 10^4 H0 sessions: mean d2 within 10% of A; Tier 2 flag rate in [alpha, 2*alpha]
[P2] zero NaN/Inf across all result fields in >= 10^4 adversarial valid inputs
[R1] full-lifecycle stream test passes detection expectations at each phase (silent steady state, flags on drift/spike, recovery silent)
test_requirements: tests/test_soak_properties.py (multi-module integration test; required to satisfy the INTEGRATION-scope [T1]/[P1]/[P3]/[P2]/[R1] invariants)
edge_cases: population window crossing winsor lookback boundary

risks.description: Singular or near-singular covariance (perfectly correlated axes, degenerate population) breaks Mahalanobis inversion in both Tier 1 joint detector and Tier 2 population stats.
risks.mitigation: ridge * I regularization on both Sigma matrices; explicit informative LinAlgError; [P2] NaN/Inf-free property tests include near-singular inputs.

risks.description: 0.0-fill of S entries during per-axis warm-up biases early joint mu/Sigma estimates.
risks.mitigation: Accepted reference-parity choice (user-approved); axis warm-up is a few ticks vs min_warm=30; revisit in v1.

risks.description: Constant metric (sigma=0) or zero-variance axis score causes division-by-zero / spurious flags.
risks.mitigation: z := 0.0 when sigma < 1e-10; per-axis flag suppressed when sigma_S <= 1e-10 (matches reference guards).

risks.description: Alert storms / flag thrashing under marginal drift degrade operator trust.
risks.mitigation: EWMA theta absorbs regime shifts by design; k defaults intentionally strict (chi2_A(0.99)); true fix = sensitivity calibration, explicitly deferred to v1 with real data (TODO documented).

risks.description: Population contamination: anomalous sessions absorbed into the population shift mu and inflate Sigma (masking effect on future detection).
risks.mitigation: Two-sided winsorization (winsor_pct=0.99, quantiles over window*winsor_k lookback, stable caps + responsive covariance); candidates never clipped [P4]; residual coordinated-drift exposure documented (Assumption 10); flagged ticks recorded for forensics.

risks.description: Duplicate session ids across ticks corrupt the population window.
risks.mitigation: absorb dedups on session_id (batch-internal and vs retained); contract documented and property-tested.

risks.description: Checkpoint schema evolution breaks previously written snapshots.
risks.mitigation: format_version column; loaders reject unknown versions with explicit ValueError.

risks.description: Partial checkpoint write (crash mid-save) corrupts the only state copy.
risks.mitigation: Atomic temp-dir + rename in save_checkpoint; pre-existing checkpoint intact on injected failure.

risks.description: Huge candidate batches (1e4-1e7 sessions) overwhelm per-tick queue build.
risks.mitigation: All Tier 2 math vectorized (batch d2 via (F-mu) @ Sigma_inv), O(S*A^2); no per-session Python loops; [P3] soak test at scale.

risks.description: Timezone / tick-alignment drift between raw-log and LLM-judge data.
risks.mitigation: Out of scope by design (Assumption 1): tick index is an integer sequence; wall-clock semantics belong to the caller. Partial/late-arriving axes are a v1+ extension.

risks.description: min_population never reached in low-volume deployments, silently disabling Tier 2.
risks.mitigation: score_sessions returns None scores with explicit note; no silent zeros.

risks.description: Aggregation function misconfiguration (unknown agg name) discovered at runtime.
risks.mitigation: Validated at config construction; registry lookup fails fast with KeyError.
